scope: Perceptive WMAC; config.motion_scope distinguishes forward walking/turning from historical joint training
explicit_differences: SuperMimic GenCoord BPTT and InstinctMJ latent objective retained instead of Hiking PPO
MuJoCo heightfield/box collision solver differs from PhysX slope-threshold triangle meshes
MuJoCo has a single sliding-friction coefficient; source dynamic friction is applied, static/restitution draws are diagnostic only
PhysX joint solver velocity limit has no direct MuJoCo equivalent; source soft velocity-limit reward retained
Local G1 MJCF pelvis free root retained; task quantities transformed to the Hiking torso frame
13 supervised physics auxiliary outputs cover contacts, torque costs, acceleration and substep timers; GenCoord physical branch remains35 velocity deltas
Measured G1 depth intrinsics at the nominal Hiking torso mount

motion_reference.expert_sampling: uniform valid ten-frame windows across all official and legacy walking clips; shared across terrains

execution_reference.scope: training scale, compiled tensor kernels and optional complete CUDA updates
execution_reference.optimizer_implementation: PyTorch 2.10 Muon math adapted to installed PyTorch 2.7

visual_reference.scope: joint-stack latent residual prediction, online reconstruction and visual stop-gradients

camera_reference.backend: MuJoCo Warp BVH over local terrain and robot visual geometry

depth_capture: Fresh post-sense successor; pre-reset terminal view captured separately; configured one-step delay only
proprioception: 8 samples per term in source term-major layout, 768 total, torso frame, gyro*.25 and joint velocity*.05
